name: Voice & Conversation Engine
_comment_core: The browser half of the voice - useInterviewerVoice and the functions
that choose and shape a voice - is M11's code living in @ai/core since
v0.14.0, because more than one module speaks (M06 now, M14 next). This
repo holds the server half and M11's own screens.
_comment_depends_on: Nothing here is required to START, and nothing is marked required: true.
Voice is never the only way through an interview: every spoken line is on
screen (FR-11.18), so an M11 outage costs sound, never a session.
`on_missing` is shown to a student: write a sentence they can act on.
Override any base_url without editing this file: M06_BASE_URL=http://...
